bagPolicy.summary: Handbags of normal size are allowed after a search. Large bags, backpacks and briefcases are prohibited, and the arena gives no size limit.
allowed: Handbags of normal size (searched at entry)
bagPolicy.note: No bag storage or check area is provided. Guests with prohibited bags are turned away to return them to their vehicles. Strollers must be checked at Guest Services.

parking.note: Parking is available around PeoplesBank Arena and throughout Downtown Hartford, with 45 lots and garages. Metered street parking is free from 6:00 pm to 8:00 am and all day on weekends. Prices vary and are managed by third-party companies.

rideshare.note: Lyft is the official rideshare partner of PeoplesBank Arena.

concessions.note: PeoplesBank Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including New England style BBQ, specialty baked potatoes, and unique pizza flavors like Peanut Butter & Bacon. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of beverages from local craft beers to mixed drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The arena partners with KultureCity, and sensory bags with KCVIP badges, fidget tools, and noise-canceling headphones can be borrowed at the Guest Services booth at Section 124. For UConn Athletics events, buy accessible seating by phone at (877) 288-2666, option 2, Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 4:30 pm.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On event days, The Hartford Ticket Office will be open 4 hours before the start of the event No third party will call or alternative pickup will be accepted at the Hartford Ticket Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is on Trumbull Street, across from Pratt Street, and the Hartford Ticket Office is just inside it.
